title: 履修登録を完了してください。（仮）
phase: Phase 4 alpha: fixed immediate annual skill display, midday timetable row and target UI; source/mock-DOM checks passed; real smartphone browser QA pending

24 additional general course definitions plus advanced faculty seminars and research

synthesized sound effects with persistent on/off switch
8 term score, graduation decision at 72 credits and all compulsory courses, saved progress and separate personal best

ai_audit.structure: PASS: JS bracket/quote balance; no missing DOM IDs from game.js and expansion.js (124 $ references against 57 HTML IDs)
ai_audit.placement_model: PASS: 3 faculties × 5 activity setups × 8 terms × 100 generated schedules (12,000 total) all reached the 10-credit registration threshold with no mandatory/activity collisions. Static matching model does not cover prerequisite gating, annual carry or actual browser behavior.
ai_audit.audio: Implementation only; sound not verified on real device
ai_audit.state_save_resume: Implementation only; 8-term save and recovery not verified in real browser
ai_audit.simulation: 8-term probabilistic graduation score distribution not measured
caveats: Simulated 225 routes with an automated course selection heuristic; not a human playtest.
The timetable generation results above do not establish a guaranteed 8-term graduation path for every random seed; progression failure is intentional.
Actual smartphone rendering, audio, save-and-resume and accessibility QA remain unverified.
The UI shows modeled pass probability rather than certainty. Scenario recalculates upon registration.
The homepage INDEX still lists the prior S8 version until the project master updates it.
ai_audit.activity_timetable_revision: PASS: tutoring occupies Mon4, Mon5, Fri5 (3 distinct periods); club+job occupies Mon5, Tue5, Wed5, Thu5, Sat3 (5 distinct periods), no overlaps.
ai_audit.runtime_simulation: PASS: 225 two-to-eight-term runs (3 faculties×5 activities×15 seeds) using a simulated DOM and deterministic course selection. 0 exceptions, 0 terms with insufficient registration, 0 mandatory/activity collisions, 101 ran to term 8 and 124 failed yearly progression; 101 reached job-hunt event; 49 annual starts/49 autumn continuations. This is a logic harness, not a browser test.
ai_audit.risk_rate_tests: PASS: representative test — neutral 92%, first period 78%, Saturday first period 71%, year 4 lower than year 1 by 12pp. Same seed gave identical activity slots. Score examples: 2 credits=200pt, 4 credits=400pt, two credits at 3 combo=300pt.
ai_audit.runtime_simulation_v05: PASS: 300 simulated logic playthroughs (3 faculties × 5 activities × 20 seeds), using mock DOM/automatic elective strategy. 151 reached final term, 149 failed earlier year requirements, 0 runtime errors, 0 registration deadlocks (registration <10 credits), 0 mandatory/activity collisions, 1874 semester instances registered >14 credits, activity block counts correct. Among 151 final-term plays 57 were graduation trip events and UI pending flag was set 57 times. These are not full real-browser UI tests.
ai_audit.score_mechanics_v05: 2 credits → 200 basic points; 4 credits → 400; plus +50 × min(5, combo index-1). Annual spring midterm 0, autumn passed earns 4 credits×100pt. Semester bonuses shown separately.
ai_audit.static_v05: PASS: game.js, expansion.js, balance.js, polish.js pass JS compilation; HTML DOM IDs for referenced fields present. Legacy hidden search input kept to protect expansion.js init binding.
outstanding: Actual smartphone browser QA has not been executed. Fullscreen annual-skill choice, safe area, lunch alignment, and 3rd-period touch hitboxes need device review.
The end-of-year skill selector appears only after meeting the year credit gate; missing skill in pre-v0.6.2 saves already advanced to a later year may require restarting for earlier years' skill.
Verify live save/resume at annual results and year-skill draft; static mock DOM and JS source checks are not a real browser test.
Check the accumulated mobility burden in late years: lunch transfer is free between periods 2 and 3, but returning from a specialist campus after later classes still uses a period.
Balancing has not been human-tested; high extracurricular schedules may have low completion odds.
Project master manages root index; no change outside s8/.
ai_audit.v052_static: PASS: all 5 JavaScript bundles compile and DOM IDs referenced by scripts exist. Source-layer first boot was checked; ADVANCED IIFE private symbol access was corrected.
ai_audit.v052_firstyear_expected_credits: 750 faculty×activity×seed models for each target load: 10 registered credits -> 7.50 expected earned, 14 -> 8.79, 20 -> 7.20, approximately 30 -> 1.69. Static expected-credit analysis, not measured grade outcomes.
ai_audit.v052_mandatory: PASS: 15 faculty×activity fixed-retake probes: all 15 repeated failed mandatory courses in the original slots next academic year. New-lectures shift to later slots; none overlapped activities or fixed classes.
ai_audit.v052_runtime: PASS with balance caveat: 150 complete-path mock-DOM runs (3 faculties × 5 activities × 10 seeded scenarios): 151 automatic required time changes, 257 registered backlog retakes, 41 visible travel periods, 0 travel overlaps, 0 execution errors. Of the 150 runs, 23 reached the end and 127 failed yearly stage requirements. Five terms had <10 available/selected credits; the prior artificial minimum was removed and grade reveal proceeded. Outcomes are highly punishing, especially for activity-heavy students, and require human difficulty review.
ai_audit.v052_campus: In-term campus movement marks an available period immediately after the last lesson before a campus switch, or after the last specialist-campus lesson when it fits; adjacent cross-campus classes cannot register; no movement after fifth period.
ai_audit.v053_runtime: PASS: 300 simulated complete playthroughs across three faculties/five activities/20 seeds. 54 reached fourth-year final results, of which six graduated, 44 failed with compulsory courses outstanding and four failed on credits alone. 342 shifted compulsory placements, 57 last-chance spring-failure retakes, zero mandatory overlaps, zero activity overlaps, zero placement deferrals, zero execution errors. Difficulty is severe; this is not human testing.
ai_audit.v053_targeted: PASS: 15/15 faculty×activity seeded fourth-year-spring-failure fixtures rescheduled a mandatory retake in fourth-year autumn; 15/15 compulsory-missing conditions displayed GAME OVER at >=72 credits; 15/15 credits-plus-all-compulsories conditions displayed graduation; stress case with 30 periods forced an explicit placement failure and GAME OVER.
ai_audit.v053_static: PASS: all five JS source files parse; referenced HTML IDs resolve in source; grade reveal year-4 CLEAR now checks compulsory backlog and placement failure.
ai_audit.v060_random_drafts: PASS mock DOM: 450 year-end choice sequences (3 faculties × 5 activities × 10 seeds × 3 school years): 450/450 showed three unique skill buttons, 450/450 selections progressed to the next semester, no exceptions. Job-hour skill appears only for job/combo; club retirement only for club/combo.
ai_audit.v060_skill_effects: PASS targeted: club retirement reduced 3 meeting slots to 0, tutoring wage raise reduced 4 to 3, past exams added 5pp to pass chance (71% to 76%), score boosting added 10% points (200pt to 220pt), and a feasible compulsory pre-class preparation reservation gave exactly 100% pass chance.
ai_audit.v060_grade: PASS mock DOM: 75 cheating-year term probes: 6 detections => six forced GAME OVER; 69 no detections; 0 errors. 40 year-four petition scenarios: 40 presented petition choices, 6 first-attempt successes and 34 failures with saved deterministic results; 0 exceptions. All-pass and all-fail grade banner cases validated.
ai_audit.v060_full_runs: PASS: 150 automatic full-term seeded strategy playthroughs (3 faculties × 5 activities × 10 seeds) terminated correctly, with 177 random yearly skill choices, 60 petitioner interactions, 21 cheating disqualifications, 100 early-year credit-gate failures, and no JS exceptions, mandatory/activity overlaps, or negative scores. This is not an actual browser test or a human success-rate evaluation.
